description: Repo-scale (sql-ecommerce): a new reviews table (dual FK) needs a consuming average-rating view too
prompts: Add a new table `reviews` to schema.sql: `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY`, `customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id)`, `product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id)`, `rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)`. Creating the table alone isn't enough - add a new view `product_average_ratings` to views.sql with columns `product_id`, `name`, `average_rating` (the AVG of that product's ratings), and `review_count` (COUNT of its reviews) - one row per product (LEFT JOIN so products with no reviews yet still appear). The two existing views are unaffected.

test_setup_files.check_average_ratings.py:
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

schema = Path('schema.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
views = Path('views.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

con = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
con.executescript(schema)
con.executescript(views)
con.executescript("""
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'Ada', 'ada@example.com'), (2, 'Bob', 'bob@example.com');
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Widget', 1000);
INSERT INTO reviews VALUES (1, 1, 1, 5);
INSERT INTO reviews VALUES (2, 2, 1, 3);
""")

row = con.execute(
    'SELECT average_rating, review_count FROM product_average_ratings WHERE product_id = 1'
).fetchone()
assert row is not None, "product_average_ratings view is missing or has no row for product 1"
avg_rating, review_count = row
assert review_count == 2, f"expected 2 reviews, got {review_count}"
assert abs(avg_rating - 4.0) < 1e-9, f"expected average rating 4.0, got {avg_rating}"

print('PASS')

reference_solution.views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_order_totals AS
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0) AS total_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

CREATE VIEW product_sales_summary AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

CREATE VIEW product_average_ratings AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating,
       COUNT(r.id) AS review_count
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
